page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number right; heading line below; a woodcut of a ram (engraving, no text inside); below it a block of verse in italic with a large initial A; signature mark at bottom right.

l.i: Has Gerè Geras Gellere solus opes.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a ram with a fleece decorated with round medallions; it has no printed text. The verse initial "A" is a large decorated letter joined to "Vrea". Several letters in the verse (G-shaped forms for "S" or "V") are set in a decorative type and were transcribed as printed; the readings "Gates", "Gnicus", "Gerè", "Geras" and "Gellere" are doubtful. The heading "Vellus Aureum. ⁊ IIII." is read from the scan; the numeral may be "IIII" as printed.
